note: Curiosity's drill holes of the boxwork campaign (real). Positions are Curiosity's MMGIS waypoints where the rover stood while drilling (frontend/src/boxwork-path.js), so each hole lies within a few metres of its point. Dates and settings from the NASA Curiosity blog. Information only: the protected zones of the rehearsal are separate, assumed sites.
source: NASA Mars Science Laboratory mission blog; positions from MMGIS MSL_waypoints.json
